business_problem: Using data to rethink customer needs while in startup mode When MYMC was first established Nishant Menon, CTO and Co-Founder, assumed their target market was purely bodybuilders and athletes.
solution_summary: Using data to rethink customer needs while in startup mode When MYMC was first established Nishant Menon, CTO and Co-Founder, assumed their target market was purely bodybuilders and athletes. MongoDB with the modern, multi-cloud database platform (Atlas) supports journey from startup to infinite scale From its earliest days, MYMC relied on MongoDB to build fast and scale its business. Our focus is to support Every Body and Every Goal,” Nishant explained. “When you adopt a data-driven approach to rethinking the customer and data infrastructure, you create an ecosystem unleashing the potential to appeal to an infinite number of customers around the world,” Nick said. In 2020 the team got a harsh lesson in availability when their existing cloud and infrastructure provider had a world-wide outage that lasted for six hours. It was huge for us and a real wake up call,” Nishant said.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas App Services
solution_components.role: Connects application logic and user experiences directly to Atlas data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the customer, catalog, and interaction data that powers My Muscle Chef's personalized user experiences.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas App Services and MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, Google Cloud, APIs.
business_outcome: Scaling from $27 million to almost $200 million in 3 years It took MYMC six years to grow its revenue to over $20 million a year.
metrics: This includes explosive revenue growth: with a more than 7x improvement on its FY18/19 revenue run rate of $27m.
architecture_clues: The deployment is designed for multi-cloud flexibility.
The deployment integrates with Google Cloud.
